create_FalAIBytedanceBaseConfig: create a FalAIBytedanceBaseConfig instance to map OpenAI-compatible image generation params to Fal AI format
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation parameters like size and response_format to Fal AI endpoint parameters
map_image_size: map OpenAI size strings like 1024x1024 to Fal AI image_size enums or custom width-height objects
create_FalAIBytedanceSeedreamV3Config: create a FalAIBytedanceSeedreamV3Config for the fal-ai/bytedance/seedream/v3/text-to-image model endpoint
create_FalAIBytedanceDreaminaV31Config: create a FalAIBytedanceDreaminaV31Config for the fal-ai/bytedance/dreamina/v3.1/text-to-image model endpoint
